nodes.description: msg.sender, the untrusted external caller of provideCapital, withdrawCapital, bTokenBuy, bTokenSell and all owner-restricted functions
block.timestamp / now, used via getPriceForMarket to compute time until option expiry
ISimpleToken tracking LP ownership of the AMM; minted and burned for liquidity providers
ERC20 collateral token used by all markets associated with this AMM
ERC20 payment token used by all markets associated with this AMM
IMarketsRegistry used to look up individual markets by assetPair
Chainlink AggregatorV3Interface used to fetch the on-chain collateral price
Volatility factor used in the Black-Scholes price approximation, owner-updatable
Flag controlling whether the global deposit limit is enforced
Maximum total pool value allowed when deposit limits are enforced
Basis point fee applied to trades
keccak256 hash of collateral and payment token addresses used to look up markets
One-time initialization guard flag
Scaling factor used to convert oracle prices into payment/collateral units
Flag indicating whether the oracle price must be inverted
MinterAmm.initialize: one-time setup of registry, oracle, tokens, lpToken proxy and pricing factors
MinterAmm.setEnforceDepositLimits: onlyOwner toggle for enforcing the global deposit limit
MinterAmm.setVolatilityFactor: onlyOwner setter for the volatility factor used in pricing
MinterAmm.setCapitalDepositLimit: onlyOwner function that is disabled and always reverts
MinterAmm.updateAmmImplementation: onlyOwner proxy upgrade entrypoint calling _updateCodeAddress
MinterAmm.enforceDepositLimit: internal check that pool value does not exceed globalDepositLimit
MinterAmm.provideCapital: LP deposits collateral, mints lpTokens, claims expired tokens
MinterAmm.withdrawCapital: burns lpTokens and returns pro-rata collateral and payment tokens
MinterAmm.claimAllExpiredTokens: iterates markets and claims wTokens of expired markets
MinterAmm.claimExpiredTokens: claims collateral from a single expired market
MinterAmm._sellOrWithdrawActiveTokens: internal helper that sells or transfers pro-rata active b/wTokens
MinterAmm.getTotalPoolValue: values all collateral, payment, active and unclaimed tokens in the pool
MinterAmm.getUnclaimedBalances: view of collateral and payment locked in expired wTokens
MinterAmm.getTokensSaleValue: view computing sale value of pro-rata LP b/wTokens
MinterAmm.getMarkets: returns the markets registered for the AMM's assetPair
MinterAmm.getMarket: returns a market by index from getMarkets
MinterAmm.getVirtualReserves: public view of bonding curve virtual reserves for a market
MinterAmm.getVirtualReservesInternal: computes virtual b/wToken reserves from balances and price
MinterAmm.getCurrentCollateralPrice: reads the Chainlink oracle and applies conversion/inversion
MinterAmm.getPriceForMarket: computes bToken price using market expiration (now), strike and oracle price
MinterAmm.calcPrice: pure Black-Scholes approximation of option price
MinterAmm.bTokenBuy: user buys bTokens with collateral, mints options if needed, transfers bTokens out
MinterAmm.bTokenSell: user sells bTokens for collateral, closing positions in the market
MinterAmm.bTokenGetCollateralIn: view computing collateral required to buy a given amount of bTokens
MinterAmm.bTokenGetCollateralOut: view wrapper around bTokenGetCollateralOutInternal
MinterAmm.bTokenGetCollateralOutInternal: internal bonding-curve math for collateral out when selling bTokens
MinterAmm.wTokenGetCollateralOutInternal: internal bonding-curve math for collateral out when selling wTokens
MinterAmm.transferOwnership: onlyOwner override delegating to OwnableUpgradeSafe
collateralToken.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), collateralAmount) inside provideCapital
lpToken.mint(msg.sender, collateralAmount/lpTokensToMint) inside provideCapital
collateralToken.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), collateralAmount) inside bTokenBuy
optionMarket.mintOptions(...) external call inside bTokenBuy after approving collateral
bToken.transfer(msg.sender, bTokenAmount) external token call at end of bTokenBuy
optionMarket.bToken().safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), bTokenAmount) inside bTokenSell
optionMarket.closePosition(closeAmount) external call inside bTokenSell
collateralToken.transfer(msg.sender, collateralAmount) external token call inside bTokenSell
optionMarket.claimCollateral(wTokenBalance) external call inside claimExpiredTokens
priceOracle.latestRoundData() external oracle call inside getCurrentCollateralPrice
_updateCodeAddress(newAmmImplementation) proxy storage upgrade with external proxiableUUID check
collateralAmount parameter of provideCapital: amount of collateral the LP deposits
lpTokenAmount parameter of withdrawCapital: amount of LP tokens burned
bTokenAmount parameter of bTokenBuy: amount of bTokens the user buys
_volatilityFactor parameter of setVolatilityFactor: new volatility value supplied by the owner
newAmmImplementation parameter of updateAmmImplementation: new logic address for the proxy
poolValue local variable in provideCapital holding getTotalPoolValue(false)
lpTokensToMint local variable in provideCapital computed from pool value and supply
collateralPrice local variable in getTotalPoolValue holding getCurrentCollateralPrice()
latestAnswer local variable in getCurrentCollateralPrice decoded from the oracle response

edges.reason: msg.sender is the LP address whose collateral is pulled and who receives minted lpTokens in provideCapital
msg.sender determines whose lpTokens are burned and who receives payouts in withdrawCapital
msg.sender pays collateral and receives bTokens in bTokenBuy
msg.sender supplies bTokens and receives collateral in bTokenSell
msg.sender is the source address of the collateral safeTransferFrom in provideCapital
msg.sender is the recipient of the lpToken mint call in provideCapital
msg.sender is the source address of the collateral safeTransferFrom in bTokenBuy
msg.sender is the recipient of the bToken transfer call in bTokenBuy
msg.sender is the recipient of the collateral transfer call in bTokenSell
msg.sender must satisfy the onlyOwner check to change enforceDepositLimits
msg.sender must satisfy the onlyOwner check to change the volatility factor
msg.sender must satisfy the onlyOwner check to call setCapitalDepositLimit
msg.sender must be the owner to upgrade the AMM implementation
msg.sender must be the owner to transfer ownership of the contract
block.timestamp (now) drives timeUntilExpiry in getPriceForMarket, making pricing timestamp dependent
timeUntilExpiry derived from block.timestamp flows into calcPrice option valuation
provideCapital constructs and executes the collateral safeTransferFrom of the deposited amount
provideCapital mints lpTokens to the LP based on collateralAmount or lpTokensToMint
bTokenBuy pulls the computed collateralAmount from the buyer via safeTransferFrom
bTokenBuy calls optionMarket.mintOptions when the AMM lacks enough bTokens
bTokenBuy transfers the purchased bTokens back to the buyer
bTokenSell pulls the seller's bTokens into the AMM via safeTransferFrom
bTokenSell calls optionMarket.closePosition for the matched b/wToken amount
bTokenSell pays the seller the computed collateralAmount
claimExpiredTokens forwards wTokenBalance into optionMarket.claimCollateral
getCurrentCollateralPrice calls priceOracle.latestRoundData and processes its answer
updateAmmImplementation passes newAmmImplementation into _updateCodeAddress
collateralToken state variable is the token whose safeTransferFrom is invoked in provideCapital
lpToken state variable is the token minted in provideCapital
collateralToken state variable is the token pulled from the buyer in bTokenBuy
collateralToken state variable is the token transferred to the seller in bTokenSell
priceOracle state variable is the oracle contract called by latestRoundData
volatilityFactor state variable is passed into calcPrice from getPriceForMarket
registry state variable is queried by getMarkets
assetPair state variable is the lookup key passed to registry.getMarketsByAssetPair
collateralAmount parameter flows into the transfer, pool value and mint computations of provideCapital
lpTokenAmount parameter drives the burn and pro-rata payout math in withdrawCapital
bTokenAmount parameter flows into bTokenGetCollateralIn and the mint/transfer logic of bTokenBuy
_volatilityFactor parameter is validated and written to volatilityFactor in setVolatilityFactor
newAmmImplementation parameter is validated and forwarded to _updateCodeAddress
poolValue local variable is used in the lpToken mint amount formula in provideCapital
lpTokensToMint local variable is derived from mul/div/sub arithmetic on pool value and supply, an overflow/underflow sensitive computation
collateralPrice local variable scales payment token values inside getTotalPoolValue
latestRoundData external call returns the answer stored in the latestAnswer local variable
latestAnswer local variable is validated and used in the conversion/inversion math of getCurrentCollateralPrice
setEnforceDepositLimits writes the enforceDepositLimits state flag
setVolatilityFactor writes the volatilityFactor state variable
initialize sets the initialized guard to true to prevent re-initialization
initialize computes and stores paymentAndCollateralConversionFactor
provideCapital calls enforceDepositLimit before minting lpTokens
withdrawCapital calls _sellOrWithdrawActiveTokens to handle pro-rata active tokens
withdrawCapital calls claimAllExpiredTokens before distributing assets
provideCapital calls claimAllExpiredTokens to convert expired wTokens into collateral
claimAllExpiredTokens calls claimExpiredTokens per expired market
getPriceForMarket calls calcPrice to value the option
getTokensSaleValue calls bTokenGetCollateralOutInternal for each open market
getTokensSaleValue calls wTokenGetCollateralOutInternal for each open market
_sellOrWithdrawActiveTokens calls bTokenGetCollateralOutInternal when selling bTokens
_sellOrWithdrawActiveTokens calls wTokenGetCollateralOutInternal when selling wTokens
bTokenBuy calls bTokenGetCollateralIn to price the purchase before pulling collateral
bTokenSell calls bTokenGetCollateralOut to compute the payout before transferring bTokens
bTokenGetCollateralOut delegates the math to bTokenGetCollateralOutInternal
getVirtualReserves delegates to getVirtualReservesInternal
bTokenGetCollateralIn calls getVirtualReserves to obtain curve reserves
bTokenGetCollateralOutInternal calls getVirtualReservesInternal
wTokenGetCollateralOutInternal calls getVirtualReservesInternal
getPriceForMarket calls getCurrentCollateralPrice for the spot price
getTotalPoolValue calls getCurrentCollateralPrice to value payment tokens
getTotalPoolValue calls getPriceForMarket to value active b/wTokens
enforceDepositLimit reads getTotalPoolValue to compare against the global deposit limit
provideCapital calls getTotalPoolValue to compute the new lpToken supply
updateAmmImplementation calls the internal _updateCodeAddress proxy upgrade routine
getMarket calls getMarkets and indexes the returned array
getPriceForMarket indirectly reads the priceOracle through getCurrentCollateralPrice
optionMarket.mintOptions is an external call that can re-enter bTokenBuy before the final bToken transfer completes
bToken.transfer is an external token callback executed at the end of bTokenBuy after collateral has been taken
optionMarket.closePosition is an external call made by bTokenSell before collateral is returned to the seller
optionMarket.claimCollateral is an external call that can re-enter claimExpiredTokens/claimAllExpiredTokens
lpToken.mint is an external call on a proxy token that could re-enter provideCapital between state reads and writes

normalization_plan.reason: collateralAmount is the function-scoped deposit amount consumed only by provideCapital and carries no independent identity
lpTokenAmount is used only within withdrawCapital to burn and compute pro-rata payouts
bTokenAmount is the trade size argument consumed only by bTokenBuy's pricing and minting logic
_volatilityFactor is validated and written to state only inside the setVolatilityFactor setter
newAmmImplementation is validated and forwarded only by updateAmmImplementation
poolValue is a temporary computation local to the provideCapital lpToken mint formula
lpTokensToMint is a temporary arithmetic result local to provideCapital before lpToken.mint
collateralPrice is a temporary local used solely to scale payment token values inside getTotalPoolValue
latestAnswer is a temporary local decoded from the oracle call and used only in getCurrentCollateralPrice
